profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: I am a data professional with extensive experience in data solutions and software development. I am as a results-oriented team player. I can be counted on to relentlessly see projects through to completion, working through obstacles and unknowns to get the job done. I have cultivated trusted relationships with fellow engineers and am sought out for my trusted guidance. My reputation for working effectively with other team members is exceptional. There are many varieties of personalities and technical skill levels in teams. I work smoothly with all parties to achieve optimal results.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Migrated Databases for High-Profile Profile Healthcare Product
•	Migrated databases from MySQL to Azure SQL with no data loss and minimal downtime
•	Designed the new solution with a focus on security, uptime, and performance for an optimal customer experience
•	Disabled public access, utilizing only private endpoints
•	Employed managed identities for application authentication
•	Implemented Entra ID for individual authentication and leveraged Privileged Identity Management for just-in-time, time-bound access
•	Utilized Failover Groups to minimize downtime during failovers
•	Leveraged Availability Zones to maximize uptime
•	Used SQL Server Migration Assistant and Azure Data Factory for data migration
•	Developed and tested a detailed runbook to ensure success
•	Drove continuous performance optimizations to improve customer experience and contain costs
•	Achieved cost reductions while significantly improving uptime

Data Retention and Compliance
•	Automated copying of data to cold storage using Azure Data Factory for long-term retention, redacting sensitive data
•	Utilized Azure Function Apps on a scheduled execution to purge data outside the retention period

Cost-Containment and Reduction
•	Conducted regular capacity reviews
•	Implemented Serverless to reduce costs
•	Recommended capacity reduction for over-provisioned services

Trusted Advisor to Engineering Teams
•	Provided guidance on architecture and best practices
•	Advised on tenancy modeling
•	Assisted with copying data between Azure tenants
•	Offered expertise in performance tuning

positions.title: Senior Principal Data Engineer
positions.description:
Migrated databases for our flagship healthcare product from on-premises SQL Server to Azure SQL with no data loss and minimal downtime

Drove continuous performance optimizations to improve customer experience and contain costs
•	Improvements supported exponential customer growth while improving uptime and keeping costs flat
•	Pivoted database from frequent outages to 100% uptime for over a year

Implemented solutions to meet High Availability and Disaster Recovery requirements

Implemented monitoring to warn of emerging problems before customers were impacted

Security hardening to align with best practices

Standardized and scripted database deployments, significantly streamlining the deployment process of our flagship product to 5 international locations

Adoption of Serverless, Elastic Pools, and Hyperscale technologies to reduce data costs

Automation of processes using Azure Pipelines to reduce labor and inconsistencies

Implementation of Availability Zones to meet uptime goals

Contributed to the Data Engineering playbook to establish best practices across the division

Documentation of procedures and policies to ensure optimal and consistent outcomes, and to facilitate succession

Mentoring of junior engineers

Capacity management, providing a balance between cost optimization and required resources

Facilitation of Data Engineering Committee to share knowledge and collaborate

Lead a data quality evaluation for a key data set, providing a status and recommendations for improvements

•	Design and implement successful database solutions that integrate with legacy systems
•	Develop and tune stored procedures for optimal performance
•	Empower management through the creation of self-service reporting

positions.title: Database Administrator
positions.description: Database design, creation, maintenance, tuning, query optimization, SSIS, DTS, replication, backup. Assist developers in creating and optimizing stored procedures. Migration of databases from Sybase to SQL Server.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
2005 - 2006: Member of the Fab Software Support team. Deliver training on manufacturing software for the help desk; created troubleshooting guides to assist the help desk and 2nd-level support in solving problems; setup monitoring of critical systems to provide early warning of problems and reduce production downtime. Provide 3rd-level and 24x7 oncall support. Development of T-SQL code to troubleshoot and provide information to customers.

2000 - 2005: Member of the Process Management software team developing and supporting applications providing critical data for accurate wafer fabrication by manufacturing tools. Provide services such as project management, systems analysis and design, database design, SQL coding and query optimization, and triggers. Participate in all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle. Recognized as the go-to person for all things database-related.

1994 - 2000: Member of the Planning software team developing and supporting factory floor scheduling, and tool capacity and utilization applications. The primary team member for database design and stored procedure development and optimization. Utilized some data warehousing concepts to speed up data retrieval.

1991 - 1994: Member of the Fabrication software team developing and supporting the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) and equipment tracking software.
